title: Implement adaptive resolution for disc visualization
description:
Convert UPSAMPLE from constant to adaptive based on lattice size L.

Formula: UPSAMPLE = max(16, min(64, int(640 / L)))
- L=10: 64 pixels/disc (crisp large discs)
- L=20: 32 pixels/disc
- L=40: 16 pixels/disc (current standard)
- L≥64: 16 pixels/disc (minimum floor)

Changes:
- Convert UPSAMPLE class constant to instance variable _upsample
- Add _calculate_upsample(l_side) static method
- Update set_l_side() to recalculate and rebuild buffers when L changes
- Ensure arrows automatically adapt to new resolution

Memory impact is acceptable (~1.6MB for L=10 vs ~100KB before).
